canonical_project: ASEAN (Bama) Big Data Cloud Computing Base phase I
notes: People's Daily Guangxi said the Hechi investment project expected to enter production in early 2023 and aimed to build Guangxi's first public-cloud big-data supercomputing platform; DTDATA reports phase I passed completion acceptance with 40,900 sq m, one data-room building, and 4,000 racks.
